summary: Mission Produce filed an 8-K reporting the expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its acquisition of Calavo Growers. Under the merger agreement, Mission Produce will acquire Calavo through two integrated mergers. The HSR waiting period expired April 17, 2026. While no price terms or premium are stated, the transaction remains subject to stockholder approvals from both companies and Mexico antitrust clearance. The parties expect consummation by July 31, 2026. Watch for shareholder vote results and Mexican antitrust approval; any delay in those conditions could widen the spread.
